name: Tower crane

parts.name: slew joint
parts.massBasis: Full upper structure: lattice jib + counter-jib (~20 m span), slew ring, operator cab, and counterweight slab. Counterweight concentrates mass toward one end, shifting COM to ~0.44 in x. Jib is an open lattice truss so x-variance is below solid-box 1/12; counterweight partially offsets by adding end mass. y/z extents are narrow relative to bounding box.

parts.name: body
parts.massBasis: Lattice steel tower mast (hollow square cross-section with cross-bracing). Mass concentrated at four corner chords and diagonal bracing, giving edge-weighted x/y variance above 1/12. Nearly uniform distribution along height. Typical ~500 kg per metre for 2.9 m square lattice section.

parts.name: trolley
parts.massBasis: Compact trolley drive unit: steel frame, geared motor, rail wheels. Nearly solid mechanical assembly with roughly uniform density, so variances close to 1/12. Slightly lower z-variance because wheels and rail gear sit at the bottom plate.

parts.name: hook suspension joint
parts.massBasis: Wire-rope cable with hook block at lower end. Cable is thin and axially symmetric so x/y variance is very small; z variance near uniform-rod value. Hook block adds mass toward one end, shifting centre slightly. Total ~40 m of 12 mm rope plus 60 kg hook assembly.
